column8: stage c is the first stage of the delivered list; nothing guards the four calls

column6: stage c: the last round, chains of length 5 (report12 page 3: lengths 2 to 5)

a chain is inconsistent when the largest normal projected 3D distance between points of equal 2D coordinate exceeds 10 voxels times (length-1); BP_MAX_XYZ_DISTANCE is 10 in parameters.h:56 and parameters.json
column8: 10 voxels is a live threshold, not a disabling one

column6: the patch in most inconsistent chains is marked bad and its chains erased, repeated until none is left; after erase() the iterator is incremented again, so the chain following an erased one is skipped in that pass (it is caught in a later pass, since the outer loop repeats while any chain remains) and an erase of the last element increments end()
column8: it runs by default; the skip delays but does not stop removal; not measured here

column6: stage vm reads badpatches.csv (stage c's output) and manualBadPatch.csv, and builds the visit orders without those patches: the offending patches are dropped from every sheet
column8: stage vm is in the delivered list and calls it unconditionally

column6: stage vm: per component, a patch whose two neighbours are placed further apart than its diameter plus their radii is a bridge; written to badbridgess_out.csv
column8: it runs inside vm, but its output file is read by no delivered stage
